citation: Rao, S. R. 1979. Lothal, a Harappan Port Town (1955–62). Memoirs of the Archaeological Survey of India No. 78, Vol. I (Text). New Delhi: Archaeological Survey of India. (Vol. II plates/later fascicle published subsequently; excavations 1955–1962.)
notes: Primary ASI Memoir No. 78 excavation report for Lothal (Gujarat). Volume I text 1979; later volume for plates. Documents planned Harappan settlement, warehouse/sealings, and a large water basin Rao identified as a dock. The dock vs reservoir identification is contested in secondary literature (e.g. Leshnik; see Kenoyer 1991 discussion) — register the basin as excavated architecture; keep ‘dockyard’ label in Notes as excavator interpretation, not settled fact. No invented seal-count tables beyond statements verified elsewhere.
